verdict.rationale: Gmail advertises standard IMAP/POP/SMTP support for non-Gmail clients, which could enable exporting mail in open formats and leaving (gmail-docs-7, gmail-docs-31, gmail-docs-6), but hands-on community reports say Gmail's IMAP implementation is broken for replicating the full Gmail experience (no unread-count sync, unsuited for the Gmail paradigm) making a full-fidelity migration away from Gmail impractical (gmail-comm-1, gmail-comm-2). There is no mention of a dedicated bulk-export tool (e.g., Takeout) or open-format guarantees for labels/metadata in the pack. missing for 10: evidence of a full open-format bulk export tool (Takeout or equivalent), confirmation that labels/threads/metadata survive export, and resolution of the documented IMAP sync/fidelity problems.
